sessions.version_end: v0.2.4 (rich-text editor Phase 1 foundation, in progress)
sessions.summary: Meeting polish + Fireflies + rich-text editor foundation. Shipped+prod-verified: AgendaHero boundness fix; Fireflies Past Meetings card + /fireflies mapping page; hero title clip fix; recurring-card iCalUID dedup bug; silent-cancel toggle + removed duplicate ID Care series. Then brainstormed/spec'd/planned the agenda rich-text editor (TipTap+Yjs+Liveblocks, HTML in Firestore) and built Phase 1 Tasks 1-4 (deps, tested HTML utils, RichBodyView, TipTap v3 editor) on local main (not pushed). Remaining: Phase 1 T5-T8 (migration util, wire into both views, run migration) + docx population from docs/Existing_Agendas; resume from the Phase-1 plan.

Long-running session (2026-05-29 → 06-02). Agenda rich-text Phase 1, full AI Integration engine (agenda gen + suggest-tasks + categorization slices 1/2/3a/3a.2/3b/5a/5b), data foundation (categories+SOPs, tags, 200 real items), Master Touch Base, org colors + meeting lifecycle — ALL shipped + prod-verified (see context.md). Then two headline features: (1) SYNC MEETING — unified single-pass AI op replacing AI Gen + Suggest Tasks (one snapshot → one streamed /api/ai/prepare call → combined review → one atomic applyUnified; retired suggest-tasks.js/AIGenDialog/SuggestTasksDialog/aiTasks.js + lastAgendaGenAt/lastSuggestTasksAt). Live E2E found+fixed: prepareMeeting data.proposal shape, cycle-based transcript window + mapping-driven inclusion, no-backdrop-dismiss. Master Sync Meeting deferred. (2) ORGANIZATIONS SETTINGS — accent banners + content-deliverables card + org-scoped member directory auto-captured from the scheduler at save (realizes the deferred external-attendee→org persistence); backfilled (Unio 16/IDCare 11/BMD 3/GV 1); fixed fireflies-bot capture. Also recovered an accidentally hard-deleted topic (Provider Profile, Biweekly Marketing Updates). All on origin/dev → vm-management-front-end.vercel.app (alias heen8sogj). version_end v0.3.0 is a best-guess bump for the two major features — adjust if your scheme differs.

Brain-dump triage → shipped two features: (1) Sync Meeting STICKY TOPIC TITLES (AI can never rename existing topics; ref-based identity + apply-side title-lock + Retained/New/Dropped diff; prod-verified incl. adversarial rename). (2) LIVE COLLABORATIVE AGENDA EDITING (Liveblocks+Yjs+TipTap; topic bodies + Open Floor; presence avatars + live cursors). Collab had an incident: false-positive verification (same-browser y-indexeddb masking) → two real bugs fixed: Vite dual-yjs (resolve.dedupe['yjs']) + brittle collabSeeded flag causing blank display (NO data lost; Firestore intact). Final fix = content-based self-healing reseed + isBlankHtml guard on all write paths (empty can never overwrite). All 9 active agendas warmed. Prod deploy o8v2v9mu7, collab ON + data-safe. ~9 brain-dump items remain (#2-#11) + board presence + collab hardening + carried v0.2.4 deferrals.

Backlog #4: Pre-Brief deprecated everywhere (client render/export/versions + AI client + 3 AI serverless fns; data dormant). Live clickable Agenda TOC shipped: pure buildTocEntries (master-aware, 8 tests), AgendaTOC component, scroll anchors (ANCHOR_SCROLL_MT=56). All 7 plan tasks committed, 64 tests green, deployed prod jql2wuwu0. Two-profile cross-user reactivity deferred to manual. Post-close: fixed Fireflies stale cache (30-min TTL, initialDataUpdatedAt); Past Meetings redesign (collapsible white card, Refresh button, rich rows, NEW badge — aa7ed8a+dd581ee+c2d7736+b783f31, fixes Terser blank-agenda production incident); fixed Sync Meeting Vistamar transcript classification (Hugo/Scot non-VM emails in Fireflies, vistamarTitleSet fallback) and label bug (5a390de+4a14839). Deployed Vercel index-Cv650NrC.js. Deferred: Sync Meeting assignee pre-fill (inferAssigneeIds exists, not wired to initial promotions state).

Collab single-writer seed guard shipped. Prevents content doubling when two clients simultaneously open a fresh empty Liveblocks room. Election: only the client with the lowest ydoc.clientID in the current awareness set seeds, after a 50ms settle delay (resets on each awareness change). New exports: SEED_SETTLE_MS + isElectedSeeder in collabSync.js (8 new tests → 72 total). Removed unused seedDocPath/seedFlagField props from CollabBodyEditor + 3 AgendaDetail callsites. Prod deploy h7jc7pk9x.

Sync Meeting category blocker fix (removed topicHasCategory guard, cbc2583). Analyzed 19 internal Vistamar Fireflies meetings → designed + seeded 5 Vistamar-internal categories (console, studio, management, business-dev, platform-ops, sortOrder 11-15). Categorized all 18 existing Vistamar board items. Key lesson: gcloud REST API writes are not visible to Firebase client SDK onSnapshot — all Firestore writes for app reflection must go through the Firebase SDK via agent-browser eval + dynamic import.

Two items from backlog: (1) Teams Join Meeting button fix — button was Working-view-only (inside ActionBar ternary); fixed by adding to AgendaHero so it shows in Overview (default view). (2) Client content deliverables seeded to Firestore for Unio/BMD/GV/IDCare via agent-browser eval; sourced from Switchboard SOPs. All four orgs now show contracted monthly content obligations in Settings → Organizations.

Favicon (backlog #11): designed 10 options in a live browser picker (localhost:8765) using brand colors extracted from vistamarconsulting.com; Andy selected Wave V (#2) — teal #1b6e9a rounded square, orange #f29248 V-chevron, subtle white wave. public/favicon.svg created, index.html updated. Also verified + pushed the Teams Join Meeting button fix from parallel session (v0.3.5, commit 77435ba). Brain-dump backlog #3 and #11 closed.

Sync Meeting subitem creation (end-to-end). AI-proposed creates can now nest one level under existing board items or other creates in the same run. parentRef string convention: '' = top-level, '{itemId}' = existing parent, 'new:N' = 0-based index into the run's creates array. validateProposal gained 4 rules + second-pass forward-ref cleanup (24 tests, TDD). applyUnified: pre-allocated doc refs (retry-idempotent), parentRef→parentId resolution, hasChildren:true on intra-run + existing parents, pre-apply guard for unchecked 'new:N' parents (caught by final code review). Review modal: Parent display line, Parent dropdown, pl:3 indent, updated header. Also shipped: assignee auto-fill from note text, Status default to AI Gen, editable title+description in modal. Deployed prod 6624fae.

Fixed 504 timeout on VM Weekly Touch Base Sync Meeting. Root cause: adaptive thinking (effort:medium) on the large master input (25 transcripts, 120 board items, 25 agendas across all orgs) generated enough tokens to exceed Vercel's maxDuration. Fix: api/ai/prepare.js — thinking: master ? { type: 'disabled' } : { type: 'adaptive' }. Cross-org aggregation is formatting not reasoning; prompt+schema fully guide the output. Non-master syncs unaffected. Fix is local on main, NOT yet pushed to origin/dev.

Previous Agenda collapsible card in Sync Meeting review step. Card appears above 'Proposed agenda', collapsed by default, renders pre-generation agenda HTML (captured at dialog-open via useState lazy init). Previous topics also threaded into /api/ai/refine so 'Bring back X and its contents' works — buildUserMessage gains ## Previous agenda block; system prompt gains one sentence directing restore from that section. 3 files: SyncMeetingDialog.jsx, aiAgenda.js, api/ai/refine.js.

Agenda bullet format guide for Sync Meeting. Brainstorm → spec → plan → subagent-driven impl. api/ai/prepare.js + api/ai/refine.js gain bulletFormatBlock (non-master only): item — Person, Status (M/D); content-social topics omit owner. AIIntegration.jsx HOW_IT_WORKS updated with bullet format section + invoicing gate + topic-title freeze (both previously undocumented). CLAUDE.md rule 4: HOW_IT_WORKS must stay in sync with every prompt/workflow change. Master Touch Base excluded; Andy verifying.

New Item Org Picker (brain-dump #3). 'New item' button always enabled for admins; clicking opens org picker dialog. One accent-colored button per org, pre-selects current orgFilter, single-tap creates blank item + sets orgFilter. In-flight guard: orgPickerCreating disables buttons + blocks backdrop/Escape dismiss during Firestore txn. Cancel leaves orgFilter unchanged. handleAddItem refactored to take explicit orgId param. TaskBoard.jsx only.

Two features: (1) INVOICING GATE (brain-dump #7) — single bullet in buildSystem() client branch: AI never creates/retains invoicing/billing topics on client agendas. Prompt-only, narrow definition, client-only. (2) COLLAPSIBLE SIDEBAR — chevron toggle in header; 240px expanded / 52px icon-only rail; default collapsed on mobile (<600px), expanded on desktop; localStorage-persisted (vm-sidebar-collapsed); useRef IIFE seed to avoid useLocalStorage timing race; Settings icon click when collapsed expands+opens children in one tap; a11y labels + padding transition.

Sticky sidebar fix. position:sticky + height:100vh on the nav Box keeps the left nav pinned while page content scrolls. Key lesson: minHeight:100vh with flex align-self:stretch lets the sidebar grow to full page height, defeating sticky — height:100vh overrides flex stretch and gives sticky the room it needs. Also committed leftover aiAgenda error type guard from v0.4.0 (handles { error: { message } } shape).

Picked #4 (deprecate Pre-Brief → live clickable TOC): wrote + reviewer-approved spec + 8-task plan (docs/superpowers/{specs,plans}/2026-06-03-prebrief-deprecation-agenda-toc*), build NOT started. An all-day COLLAB OUTAGE interrupted it: Vercel LIVEBLOCKS_SECRET_KEY had been set to an sk_live_ (production) key ~17h prior but the Liveblocks app is the dev environment (sk_dev_) → Liveblocks rejected every room (4001 'no access') → all agenda topic bodies blank. NOT data loss (Firestore bodyHtml intact), NOT the seed code. Fixed by restoring the sk_dev_ key in Vercel + `vercel deploy --prod`. Collab RESTORED + verified (two real users, live cursors). Also shipped: content-based self-healing reseed (bf6ee7a), bounded room ids for an over-long 181-char agenda doc id (6b8344e); reverted the server-AI Pre-Brief change (2f64228) to keep deploys collab-only. Doubling incident on the Biweekly agenda (two-window concurrent seed race) recovered via Liveblocks REST room-delete + single-client reseed → proves the single-writer seed guard is now HIGH priority. Prod alias → mka8mzc3i. Preview-scope Liveblocks key still unset (CLI quirk). Memory: reference_liveblocks_dev_key.

Sync Meeting board section redesign. Flat form-fields (TextFields/Selects) in the review step replaced with board-style rows. NEW: ProposedBoardRow.jsx — 3-row layout (title+status+assignee / category-bordered-pill+tag-dot+text / AI-note-italic); 15 tests; useEffect titleValue sync added after pre-push review caught stale-state bug. MODIFIED: SyncMeetingDialog creates->blue 'New Items' header+ProposedBoardRow map; moves->orange 'Status Updates' header+pill->arrow->pill rows (STATUS_BY_NAME for AI string status names); promotions state expanded { statusId, assigneeIds?, categoryId, tagIds }; dead code purged. MODIFIED: aiAgenda.js applyUnified prefers promo.categoryId/tagIds (!==undefined guard). 106/106 tests. Deployed Vercel. Opened with /to-do; re-verified the reconstructed backlog against code/git (3 agents) — 6 items reconciled as shipped/obsolete, open list ~26→~13. Then fixed two confirmed-live, client-facing latent bugs in the Send Meeting Prep email path: (1) Postmark silent-success — relay-mail.js sendRelay() only checked res.ok, so HTTP-200-with-non-zero-ErrorCode failures (406 inactive recipient etc.) reported as sent and mail silently never arrived; now parses the body and throws on non-zero ErrorCode. (2) ActionBar read the dormant openFloor subcollection instead of the migrated agenda.openFloorHtml; new htmlToLines() helper in agendaHtml.js flattens it, dead subscription + prop removed. 11 new tests, suite 91/91, build clean. NOT live-sent (would email real attendees). Also committed 4 orphaned design docs. Deferred: send-prep.js still passes only Topic_Name (no talking points) — same staleness class, fast-follow candidate. Not pushed (pre-push code review pending).

Reschedule bug fix + meeting calendar hygiene. Root-caused 'can't reschedule BMD biweekly' (Graph ErrorOccurrenceCrossingBoundary): the RescheduleDialog's meeting object was built by a useMemo missing nextOccurrence from its deps, so it stayed frozen on the stored meetingDatetime (Aug 13) while the hero showed the live next occurrence (Jul 2); moving the wrong instance backward across neighbors triggered the Graph error. Fix (AgendaDetail.jsx, fe23ea8): add nextOccurrence+isRecurring to deps -> dialog + hero agree. Deployed prod (READY, vm-management-front-end.vercel.app), Andy confirmed BMD works. Then full recurring-meeting audit: built dev/audit-recurring-meetings.mjs + diag/cancel toolkit (10 scripts, commit 69894af, gitignore .env.vercel). Found + cancelled 3 Apr-8 internal-only ghost series (GV, Unio-Weekly, Unio-Biweekly) that shadowed real client meetings on meetings@ Graph (Graph-only, not Google-mirrored, no clients). Final audit 0 dup/0 diverged/0 ghost. Key learning: FE meeting list aggregates Google mirror across meetings@/Tate/Cedric; a Graph-only series is never FE-attached. Memory added: project_meeting_calendar_architecture, reference_meeting_diagnostics_toolkit. Fix+toolkit on main->dev + cherry-picked onto studio-integration-proxy (d75275a, 1f85ee6). Deferred: dependabot 37 vulns, reschedule cross-boundary UX pre-flight, audit-across-all-calendars, Firestore linkage audit.

BMD - Biweekly blank-agenda incident, root-caused + repaired + swept. Root cause: the Google mirror of 'BMD - Biweekly' split into a new recurrence master (_R20260702T183000) at the Jul 2 boundary while Graph stayed one intact series; agendas are keyed by the Google recurrence-master id, so reconcileMeetings minted a fresh EMPTY agenda for the new master and the app routed upcoming occurrences (Jul 16+) there, stranding the team's 4 topics + Fireflies history on the prior master's doc (_R20260521T183000). The 'BMD ad hoc Content Strategy' meeting Andy made the night before was a separate series (5pk0be...), NOT the cause. Fix: copy-forward the stranded content (topics + firefliesTitles + 5 versions) to the live master doc via dev/repair-bmd-biweekly-content.mjs (dry-run-first, guarded, gcloud->Firestore REST); Firestore bodyHtml is canonical and the Liveblocks room self-seeds from it, so no collab surgery. Verified server-side (bodyHtml byte-for-byte) + Andy confirmed live. Then full strand audit across BOTH vectors (recurrence-split + dual-id NewMeetingDialog shadow) via dev/audit-agenda-strands.mjs across meetings@/Tate/Cedric Google calendars: BMD was the only recoverable strand; GV-Vistamar has an empty live agenda but no content stored anywhere (not a strand). No app code changed — production data repair only. 4 new dev scripts untracked (not committed). Memory added: project_agenda_recurrence_split_bug. DEFERRED: durable fix = key agendas by stable Graph seriesMasterId/iCalUID or carry content forward on split (else re-strands on next this-and-following reschedule); GV empty-agenda question; commit the new scripts; + carried v0.4.4 deferrals (dependabot 37 vulns, reschedule UX pre-flight).
